messages:
Alex P.: Heads up — while prepping the new onboarding deck I hit a 404 in the runtime guide: example snippet link points to /samples/old-embed.js :face_palm:
Tammy D.: which page exactly? can you paste the URL?
Alex P.: https://docs.redwood.ai/runtime/kv-cache#snippet-embed (the inline example calls /samples/old-embed.js)
link-scan-bot: Automated scan found 1 dead link in docs/runtime/kv-cache.md at line 72 — https://internal.ci/scan/7865
Mike S.: I can take this, looks like an S3 rehost case. Is it in CODEOWNERS for docs/infra?
Tammy D.: docs/maintainers are the codeowners for that path — can you add them @Mike S. and open a tiny PR? :+1:
Mike S.: yup, will open PR and tag @Tammy D. for review. quick change, replace URL to /samples/kv-cache-rehosted.js
Alex P.: thanks — also can we add a tiny smoke curl to the doc so this gets caught by the next link-scan? e.g.
Alex P.: ```bash
curl -fsS https://docs.redwood.ai/runtime/kv-cache | grep samples/kv-cache-rehosted.js
```
Tammy D.: yes please add that and a one-line note in the changelog. keep it tiny so we can get it through today
eng-oncall: FYI if this requires changing S3 redirects, ping infra-oncall and include the broken object key: samples/old-embed.js
Mike S.: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/842 — replaces link, adds smoke curl, updates changelog. reviewers: @Tammy D.
Tammy D.: reviewing now. quick nit: could you also add a redirect entry to redirect-map.yaml? small.
Mike S.: adding redirect in same PR, pushed. diff snippet:
Mike S.: ```yaml
- "samples/old-embed.js": null
+ "samples/old-embed.js": "/samples/kv-cache-rehosted.js"
```
Tammy D.: LGTM, merging after CI passes. thanks everyone :tada:
Alex P.: amazing, thanks team — will update onboarding deck and re-run the slides smoke tests
link-scan-bot: CI link-check passed for PR 842 — 0 new failures
Alex P.: closing the loop here. if infra needs the S3 key let me know, otherwise all set
eng-oncall: copied, will stand down unless infra asks for manual redirect.
